lessons.title: Introduction to Python and Django
lessons.description: In this lesson, students will learn the basics of Python programming and how to set up a Django project. They will write their first Django application and understand the structure of a Django project.

lessons.title: Advanced Django Concepts and Best Practices
lessons.description: This lesson delves into more advanced topics such as form handling, authentication, and integration with external APIs. Students will also learn about testing and deployment strategies in Django.
